maddeler.e:
نقتبس (form VIII)
# نَقْتَبِسُ (naqtabisu) /naq.ta.bi.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
# نُقْتَبَسُ (nuqtabasu) /nuq.ta.ba.su/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
# نَقْتَبِسَ (naqtabisa) /naq.ta.bi.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
# نُقْتَبَسَ (nuqtabasa) /nuq.ta.ba.sa/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
